purpose: Eight synthetic multi-turn Indonesian and English conversations (28 evaluated steps) testing transcript-grounded evidence verification, multi-turn state progression, and end-to-end conversation extraction. Not a representative benchmark; labels are single-reviewer exploratory annotations.

review.limitation: Conversations, step proposals, and expected labels are synthetic and single-reviewed by the repository author. Treat all labels as exploratory single-reviewer annotations.

notes: Synthetic Indonesian and English dialogues; contains no HaluMem, LoCoMo, or private user conversation data.
Paired step evaluation verifies fixed step transitions against live transcript slices under transcript-grounding checks.
End-to-end raw-transcript extraction replay feeds only the raw transcripts into RuleBasedConversationExtractor with no pre-authored step proposals.
